_about: Sample inputs for scripts/check-links.mjs. Genuine sites are well-known and long-lived. Fake/dummy names are made up for testing (they imitate banks and offices on purpose); most do not exist, which is fine: the app judges the name and says the site could not be reached.

genuineSites.note: Wikipedia (not in the brand list: scores on age, HTTPS and clean reputation)

brokenPages.note: Real domain, dead page: the Trust Check should stay good, the page itself reports an error

fakeSites.note: Bank name placed in front of another website, plain http
Bank name inside a longer address, plain http
Official-looking name on a cheap ending
Zero instead of the letter o
Real-looking bank domain used as a prefix, plain http
No brand at all: a generic login bait on a cheap ending (expect Be Careful or Likely Fake)
